coverage_notes: I used all 22 searches and found no new Duke-alumni decision makers at the fintech and crypto funds I was given. Every named partner I checked shows non-Duke schools, or no Duke link at all. The two generic searches ('Duke' alum + crypto GP; Duke + fintech managing partner pre-seed) turned up only Fred Ehrsam and Logan Allin, who are both already on the found list. Amias Gerety (QED) is the only open question. One search summary credited him with a Duke Law JD, but the source PDF can't be fetched and three follow-up searches showed only his Harvard BA, so I've listed him as not Duke with that caveat. Searches by firm with several names joined by OR seldom turned up schools; searching one person at a time worked much better. These pages could hold new names, but they need a fetch or a site-restricted search: the Duke FinTech MEng advisory board (https://masters.pratt.duke.edu/fintech/advisory-board/, which includes fintech VCs), the Duke I&E 'Network in the News' page (https://entrepreneurship.duke.edu/news-events/duke-ie-network-news/), and Darryl Landis of Mustard Seed Venture Partners, who appeared in a Duke/Fuqua fintech search with no Duke degree shown.
